name: hero-liquid-metal

frames.best_why: Concentric teal rings cover the whole glossy slab and no cursor or edge clipping distracts from it.

tagline: Glossy teal liquid metal ripples beside a headline and pill button.
summary: A split landing hero: a large two-line heading, short paragraph, pill button and two tech badges on the left, and a rounded block of iridescent liquid metal on the right. Concentric teal rings keep rolling across the glossy surface.
appearance: On black, a left column stacks a big white two-line heading, a dim grey paragraph, an outlined pill button and two bordered badges. The right side is a rounded-rectangle slab of glossy metal, its dark surface crossed by bright teal and pale cyan concentric rings.
behaviour: The rings ripple and slide across the metal like slow waves, so highlights and dark bands keep trading places. The text and controls hold still; hover lifts the button and badges, and on small screens the metal becomes a dimmed band under the copy.
demo_content: Heading AI SDK Agents / Copy and Paste, copy about Vercel AI SDK, Next.js v16 and AI SDK v6 badges.
search_phrases: split hero text and shiny 3d shape
molten chrome background for landing page
use_when: A product page wants a premium metallic visual that moves on its own beside or behind the headline.
avoid_when: A perpetual WebGL shader that needs a sized parent, with a fixed glossy teal palette tied to this demo.
customise: All copy, CTA and badges arrive as props, and the shader takes width, tint, distortion, speed and repetition. Layout and the metal shape need class or source edits.
weight_why: A liquid-metal WebGL shader keeps rippling every frame across half the hero.

a11y.note: A hidden h1 names the hero and the link carries text, but the constant shader motion ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The description is small and dim against black, so it is hard to read at a glance.
polish_why: Convincing glossy metal and a balanced split; the small dim body copy is the weak point.
